acceptance_matrix.criterion: Finding 1: Affirmative causal and paper-safety telemetry assertions; fail-closed when stripped or real writes present; adversarial test.
acceptance_matrix.evidence: scripts/probe_dev_runtime_paper_lifecycle.py enforces affirmative assertions that is_real_capital is False, is_real_order is False, broker_submission_status == 'filled', artifact_signal_not_smoke is True, source_snapshot_driven is True, with exact binding_id, artifact_id, runtime_id, and correlation_id checks. Stripped events fail closed. test_adversarial_stripped_telemetry_fails_closed verifies rejection.

acceptance_matrix.criterion: Finding 2: Authoritative Loop 8 saga readback without invented fallback; inbox receipt applied by deployment-outbox-consumer; DEP-003 projection validation.
acceptance_matrix.evidence: GET /api/deployment/sagas/{saga_id} polls terminal status without invented saga ID fallback. Loop 8 next-consumer receipt is retrieved from GET /api/deployment/inbox with aggregate_id and consumer_name=deployment-outbox-consumer, validating receipt_id != binding_id and status='applied'. DEP-003 projection read from /api/deployment/projections/{plan_id} is verified.

acceptance_matrix.criterion: Finding 3: Authenticated hosted contract with Bearer and tenant headers; canonical joined routes; honest double 401/404 fail-closed behavior.
acceptance_matrix.evidence: CanonicalOwnerAdapter injects Authorization: Bearer and X-Tenant-Id headers across all requests. join_url() prevents duplicate '/api/...' segments. HonestCanonicalOwnerDouble rejects missing auth with HTTP 401 and unmapped routes with HTTP 404 instead of defaulting to HTTP 200.

acceptance_matrix.criterion: Finding 4: Strict durable reload comparing full identity, checksum, safety flags, and DEP-003 projection; honest fresh_client_isolated reporting; independent trade episode consumer receipt separated from liveness heartbeat.
acceptance_matrix.evidence: _verify_durable_reload compares plan_id, runtime_id, artifact_id, artifact_version, capital_pool_id, symbol, checksum, and DEP-003 projection contract. fresh_client_isolated is True only when fresh_transport_factory is supplied. Liveness heartbeat and independent trade episode consumer receipt (GET /api/telemetry/trade-episodes) are queried and validated as separate distinct receipts.

acceptance_matrix.criterion: Finding 5: Preflight fails closed on missing/invalid 40-hex SHAs, FE manifest bffCommit/backendSha mismatch with BFF, malformed buildMode, unverified config_posture, missing environment, and pairId mismatch; authoritative parent artifact discovery.
acceptance_matrix.evidence: run_preflight() strictly validates 40-hex SHAs, requires FE manifest's bffCommit/backendSha to match the running BFF commit, verifies buildMode (live, strict, no real writes) and config_posture (strict auth mode, no auth_stub), requires environment, and validates pair linkage. Approved parent strategy artifact is authoritatively discovered from /api/registry/strategies/tw_session_momentum/strategy-artifacts for rollback target lineage.

acceptance_matrix.criterion: Deliver exact-head dev PR with focused local test evidence; do not merge or run hosted write probes because root GPT-6 Astra owns integration and validation.
acceptance_matrix.evidence: All 29 contract and adversarial unit tests pass locally with honest test double; py_compile and git diff --check pass cleanly; ready for review handoff to Claude.
